name: copernicus
description: GPT-only Fleet, decision-compressed Breathe investigations, SAS+OKF auto-research, HTML reports, and Rick Rubin subtraction for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: GPT-only fleets, deep briefs, and research.
interface.longDescription: Five bundled Codex workflows: subtract weak ideas, execute bounded Sol/Terra/Luna work, compress deep investigation at the human decision boundary, learn through evaluated SAS cycles with locally integrity-checked receipts and OKF memory, then explain evaluated work in a portable HTML report.
defaultPrompt: Use $rick-rubin to find the essence, what stays, what goes, and the hardest cut.
Use $fleet to split this mission into bounded GPT-only seats and verify the synthesis.
Use $breathe to investigate deeply with Luna waves and return only a decision-complete brief.
Use $auto-research for one evidence-backed cycle and propose OKF knowledge.
Use $html-report to turn evaluated evidence into a portable human-facing briefing.
